messages:
Ayesha: Heads up — Acme is moving 40 seats to a new BU on 2026-06-01 and wants billing split. Current annual commit is $120k. Need to confirm how we handle mid-term seat migration and signer auth for the amendment.
Ben: Do we need to reprice or is this a seat redistribution only?
Ayesha: They requested a two-line invoice (BU-A / BU-B) and an amendment to the SOW for migration support. They also want the signer to be SSO-verified from their IdP.
matt.billing: Two-line billing OK, but splitting changes proration and recognition. I need the migration effective date and PO for new BU.
Alex (Finance): If seats move 6/1 mid-term we should prorate seats for remaining term. Example calc: if annual, 40 seats moved for 7 months => proration applicable. Provide effective date and new entity tax ID.
Ayesha: Got it. I'll request PO and tax ID from the customer and ask for BU legal contact.
Ben: Customer confirmed BU legal contact is Sara Palmer s.palmer@customer.com. They agreed to the migration conceptually but need quote and a one-time migration fee.
Olivia (Legal): On signer auth: they require identity proofing. Our hosted flow only supports DocuSign KBA/phone verification today. SSO-attested signing is supported for Private deployments only.
legal-bot: Note: DocuSign KBA is permitted for US legal signatures; EU customers may require eIDAS.
Sophie (Product): Status: SSO-attestation for signatures is on the roadmap but not GA. Recommend KBA for now.
matt.billing: I'll draft an updated quote with two-line billing, include a one-time migration support line item of $6,000, and show proration math. Will target EOD Friday.
Alex (Finance): Add a billing entity switch date in the quote so AR knows when to route invoices. Also include the new PO placeholder so we can lock revenue once PO arrives.
Ayesha: Customer asked that invoice for BU-B be sent to new PO number once they provide it. They expect the migration support fee on the first invoice after cutover.
Olivia (Legal): I'll prepare an amendment that references seat migration and adds migration support. If signer must be SSO-verified, we'll include an alternate clause to accept DocuSign KBA for hosted customers.
Ben: Thanks — my ask: Ayesha to confirm PO and tax ID, matt to send updated quote, Olivia to send amendment draft, Alex to confirm accounting implications. I'll coordinate signature once docs are ready.
Ayesha: Pinged Sara for PO + tax ID. She said procurement will supply PO within 48 hours.
ops-bot: Reminder: If we accept KBA for hosted customers, enable DocuSign KBA flag in contract workflow.
Sophie (Product): Noted. We'll check if any consent toggles are needed on the tenant side.
Ben: Moving to action items — follow-up next week. :thumbsup:
